case.summary: Customer C09582 disputed transaction 3660350 ($236.28) on card C09582-K1. Analysis of transaction records revealed a classic card-testing sequence on 2017-01-14, wherein four small online product C authorizations between $1.53 and $3.46 were executed within 27 minutes directly preceding the disputed purchase. This sudden online activity represents an anomalous departure from the cardholder's baseline of 219 consecutive in-person product W transactions. Under Rule R5, the activity is confirmed as card-testing fraud with a total exposure of $246.38, resulting in the card being blocked and pending charges declined.
